## Purpose

::: {.walkthrough-grid}
::: {.walkthrough-step}
**Step 1 - Cluster expression**

Group main-chromosome DEGs by their row-scaled VST profiles across all samples.
:::
::: {.walkthrough-step}
**Step 2 - Test functions**

Run GO and eukaryote-inclusive KEGG enrichment within each expression cluster.
:::
::: {.walkthrough-step}
**Step 3 - Interpret patterns**

Read expression, DEG context, fungal signal, and enrichment as one figure.
:::
:::

This page rebuilds the gene-level expression clusters using only significant
main-chromosome fat body DEGs from the joint all-samples model. The current
publication composite retains the earlier three-block display for continuity,
but that grouping is provisional. The full unpartitioned gene dendrogram and
its exactly aligned heatmap are shown below so that new boundaries can be chosen
from the current chromosome-only data rather than inherited from the older run.

The foreground is the exported gene list for that circled branch. The enrichment
is run in two ways:

- against all expressed main-chromosome genes in the rRNA-filtered count matrix;
- against all genes in the full all-samples fat body DEG heatmap.

The first test asks what functions are over-represented compared with the whole
expressed transcriptome. The second test asks what makes this heatmap branch
different from the other fat body DEGs.

For GO enrichment, only terms that resolve to Biological process, Cellular
component, or Molecular function in the local GO database are kept in the final
tables and plots. Unresolved GO identifiers are omitted here because they do not
provide an interpretable functional label.

**Current cluster decision:** [Open the searchable unmerged four-branch
review](#unmerged-four-branch-review) before deciding which branches should be
merged in the publication figure.

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

figure3_path_ancestors <- function(path) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = FALSE)
  ancestors <- path
  repeat {
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) break
    ancestors <- c(ancestors, parent)
    path <- parent
  }
  ancestors
}

is_figure3_project <- function(path) {
  file.exists(file.path(path, "analysis", "26-circled-cluster-enrichment.Rmd")) &&
    dir.exists(file.path(path, "data")) &&
    dir.exists(file.path(path, "output"))
}

find_figure3_project <- function() {
  starts <- character()

  explicit_root <- Sys.getenv("GREGARIA_DIET_PROJECT_DIR", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(explicit_root)) starts <- c(starts, explicit_root)

  input_file <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
                         error = function(e) "")
  if (length(input_file) == 1 && nzchar(input_file)) {
    starts <- c(starts, dirname(input_file))
  }

  if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) &&
      rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
    active_file <- tryCatch(
      rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path,
      error = function(e) ""
    )
    if (length(active_file) == 1 && nzchar(active_file)) {
      starts <- c(starts, dirname(active_file))
    }
  }

  starts <- unique(c(starts, getwd()))
  candidates <- unique(unlist(
    lapply(starts, figure3_path_ancestors),
    use.names = FALSE
  ))
  matches <- candidates[vapply(candidates, is_figure3_project, logical(1))]

  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not locate gregaria-diet-infection-interaction. ",
      "Open this Rmd from that project, set the working directory to the ",
      "repository root, or set GREGARIA_DIET_PROJECT_DIR explicitly."
    )
  }

  normalizePath(matches[1], mustWork = TRUE)
}
```

## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
latest_dir <- function(pattern) {
  dirs <- list.dirs(results_root, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  dirs <- dirs[grepl(pattern, basename(dirs))]
  if (length(dirs) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  dirs[which.max(file.info(dirs)$mtime)]
}

resolve_cluster_file <- function(path_param) {
  explicit_path <- if (is.null(path_param) || !nzchar(path_param)) {
    NA_character_
  } else if (grepl("^/", path_param)) {
    path_param
  } else {
    file.path(project_dir, path_param)
  }
  if (!is.na(explicit_path) && file.exists(explicit_path)) {
    return(explicit_path)
  }

  phase_dir <- latest_dir("^phase-signature-overlap_")
  if (is.na(phase_dir)) return(explicit_path)

  candidate <- file.path(
    phase_dir,
    "circled_upper_cluster_audit",
    "circled_upper_cluster_genes.csv"
  )
  candidate
}

read_emapper <- function(path) {
  cols <- c(
    "query", "seed_ortholog", "evalue", "score", "eggNOG_OGs",
    "max_annot_lvl", "COG_category", "Description", "Preferred_name",
    "GOs", "EC", "KEGG_ko", "KEGG_Pathway", "KEGG_Module",
    "KEGG_Reaction", "KEGG_rclass", "BRITE", "KEGG_TC", "CAZy",
    "BiGG_Reaction", "PFAMs"
  )
  tab <- read.delim(path, comment.char = "#", header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
                    quote = "", fill = TRUE)
  names(tab) <- cols[seq_len(ncol(tab))]
  tab |>
    dplyr::mutate(protein_id = stringr::str_extract(query, "XP_[0-9]+[.][0-9]+"))
}

parse_cds_gene_bridge <- function(path) {
  gff <- read.delim(path, comment.char = "#", header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
                    quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(gff)[1:9] <- c("seqid", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score",
                       "strand", "phase", "attributes")
  gff |>
    dplyr::filter(type == "CDS") |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      protein_id = stringr::str_match(attributes, "protein_id=([^;]+)")[, 2],
      gene_id = stringr::str_match(attributes, "gene=([^;]+)")[, 2]
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(protein_id), !is.na(gene_id)) |>
    dplyr::distinct()
}

parse_gff_gene_annotation <- function(path) {
  gff <- read.delim(path, comment.char = "#", header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
                    quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(gff)[1:9] <- c("seqid", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score",
                       "strand", "phase", "attributes")
  gff |>
    dplyr::filter(type == "gene") |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene_id = dplyr::coalesce(
        stringr::str_match(attributes, "gene=([^;]+)")[, 2],
        stringr::str_match(attributes, "Name=([^;]+)")[, 2]
      ),
      Description = stringr::str_match(attributes, "description=([^;]+)")[, 2],
      gene_biotype = stringr::str_match(attributes, "gene_biotype=([^;]+)")[, 2]
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_id)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(Description) | Description == "",
        "no GFF description",
        utils::URLdecode(Description)
      ),
      gene_biotype = dplyr::coalesce(gene_biotype, "unknown")
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

read_metadata <- function(path) {
  tab <- read.delim(path, check.names = FALSE)
  tab <- tab[, !is.na(names(tab)) & nzchar(names(tab)), drop = FALSE]
  tab$label <- as.character(tab$label)
  tab$Diet <- factor(tab$Diet, levels = c("33", "50", "83"))
  tab$Treatment <- factor(tab$Treatment, levels = c("Infected", "Control"))
  tab
}

read_featurecounts_gene_counts <- function(path, sample_id) {
  tab <- read.delim(path, comment.char = "#", check.names = FALSE)
  if ("Geneid" %in% names(tab)) {
    count_col <- names(tab)[ncol(tab)]
    out <- tibble::tibble(
      gene_id = as.character(tab[["Geneid"]]),
      count = as.integer(tab[[count_col]])
    )
  } else {
    tab <- read.delim(path, comment.char = "#", header = FALSE,
                      check.names = FALSE)
    if (ncol(tab) < 2) {
      stop("Count file must contain at least gene ID and count columns: ", path)
    }
    out <- tibble::tibble(
      gene_id = as.character(tab[[1]]),
      count = as.integer(tab[[ncol(tab)]])
    )
  }
  out <- out |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_id), nzchar(gene_id)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  names(out)[2] <- sample_id
  out
}

parse_head_thorax_reference_metadata <- function(reference_dir) {
  files <- list.files(
    reference_dir,
    pattern = "^SGRE-(HEAD|THOX)-(CRD|ISO)-[0-9]+_MERGE_featurecounts[.]txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      sample_id = character(),
      count_file = character(),
      tissue = character(),
      phase = character(),
      rearing_condition = character(),
      replicate = integer(),
      source = character(),
      display_group = character(),
      reference_role = character(),
      sample_label = character(),
      sample_block = character()
    ))
  }

  parsed <- stringr::str_match(
    basename(files),
    "^SGRE-(HEAD|THOX)-(CRD|ISO)-([0-9]+)_MERGE_featurecounts[.]txt$"
  )
  tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = stringr::str_remove(basename(files), "_featurecounts[.]txt$"),
    count_file = files,
    tissue_code = parsed[, 2],
    rearing_code = parsed[, 3],
    replicate = as.integer(parsed[, 4])
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tissue_code), !is.na(rearing_code)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      tissue = dplyr::case_when(
        tissue_code == "HEAD" ~ "Head",
        tissue_code == "THOX" ~ "Thorax",
        TRUE ~ tissue_code
      ),
      phase = dplyr::case_when(
        rearing_code == "CRD" ~ "Gregarious",
        rearing_code == "ISO" ~ "Solitarious",
        TRUE ~ rearing_code
      ),
      rearing_condition = dplyr::case_when(
        rearing_code == "CRD" ~ "Crowded",
        rearing_code == "ISO" ~ "Isolated",
        TRUE ~ rearing_code
      ),
      source = "Time-course head/thorax phase reference",
      display_group = paste0(
        tissue, ": ",
        dplyr::if_else(rearing_condition == "Crowded",
                       "crowded/gregarious", "isolated/solitarious")
      ),
      reference_role = paste(tissue, tolower(rearing_condition),
                             "rep", replicate),
      sample_label = paste0(substr(tissue, 1, 1), "-",
                            rearing_code, "-", replicate),
      sample_block = paste(tissue, "reference")
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(tissue, rearing_condition, replicate)
}

first_nonempty <- function(x, fallback = "") {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "-"]
  if (length(x) == 0) fallback else x[1]
}

build_term_maps_from_eggnog <- function() {
  counts_raw <- read.csv(counts_file, check.names = FALSE)
  gene_universe <- unique(counts_raw[[1]])
  annotation <- read_emapper(eggnog_file) |>
    dplyr::left_join(parse_cds_gene_bridge(gff_file), by = "protein_id") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_id), gene_id %in% gene_universe) |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      GOs = first_nonempty(GOs, ""),
      KEGG_Pathway = first_nonempty(KEGG_Pathway, ""),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  term2gene_go <- annotation |>
    dplyr::select(gene_id, GOs) |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^GO:", GOs)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(term = GOs, gene = gene_id) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  go_names <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    GO.db::GO.db,
    keys = unique(term2gene_go$term),
    keytype = "GOID",
    column = "TERM",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
  go_ontology <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    GO.db::GO.db,
    keys = unique(term2gene_go$term),
    keytype = "GOID",
    column = "ONTOLOGY",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
  term2name_go <- data.frame(
    term = names(go_names),
    name = unname(go_names),
    ontology = unname(go_ontology)
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(name))

  term2gene_kegg <- annotation |>
    dplyr::select(gene_id, KEGG_Pathway) |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^ko[0-9]+$", KEGG_Pathway)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(term = KEGG_Pathway, gene = gene_id) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  term2name_kegg <- term2gene_kegg |>
    dplyr::distinct(term) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      name = term,
      pathway_theme = "Other KEGG pathway",
      pathway_scope = "Unclassified KEGG reference label"
    )

  list(
    term2gene_go = term2gene_go,
    term2name_go = term2name_go,
    term2gene_kegg = term2gene_kegg,
    term2name_kegg = term2name_kegg
  )
}

load_term_maps <- function() {
  go_dir <- latest_dir("^go-term-enrichment_")
  expected <- file.path(
    go_dir,
    c("eggNOG_GO_TERM2GENE.csv", "eggNOG_GO_TERM2NAME.csv",
      "eggNOG_KEGG_pathway_TERM2GENE.csv",
      "eggNOG_KEGG_pathway_TERM2NAME.csv")
  )
  if (!is.na(go_dir) && all(file.exists(expected))) {
    return(list(
      term2gene_go = read.csv(expected[1], check.names = FALSE),
      term2name_go = read.csv(expected[2], check.names = FALSE),
      term2gene_kegg = read.csv(expected[3], check.names = FALSE),
      term2name_kegg = read.csv(expected[4], check.names = FALSE)
    ))
  }
  build_term_maps_from_eggnog()
}

run_enrichment <- function(genes, universe, term2gene, term2name, database,
                           background_label) {
  term2gene <- term2gene |>
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% universe) |>
    dplyr::distinct(term, gene)
  term2name_min <- term2name |>
    dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::select(term, name)

  tested_universe <- intersect(universe, term2gene$gene)
  tested_genes <- intersect(genes, tested_universe)
  if (length(tested_genes) < 5 || length(tested_universe) < 10) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  res <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
    gene = tested_genes,
    universe = tested_universe,
    TERM2GENE = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME = term2name_min,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 5,
    maxGSSize = 5000
  )
  if (is.null(res)) return(data.frame())
  out <- as.data.frame(res)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(data.frame())
  out |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      database = database,
      background = background_label,
      foreground_genes_tested = length(tested_genes),
      background_genes_tested = length(tested_universe)
    )
}

expand_term_genes <- function(tab, gene_annotation) {
  if (nrow(tab) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }
  tab |>
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
    dplyr::select(database, background, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                  pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, Count, geneID) |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
    dplyr::rename(term_id = ID, term_name = Description, gene_id = geneID) |>
    dplyr::left_join(gene_annotation, by = "gene_id")
}
```

```{r build-input-sets}
gff_annotation <- parse_gff_gene_annotation(gff_file)
counts_table <- readr::read_tsv(counts_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
counts <- as.matrix(counts_table[, setdiff(names(counts_table), "gene_id"), drop = FALSE])
rownames(counts) <- counts_table$gene_id
storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"

placement <- readr::read_tsv(placement_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
rrna_ids <- trimws(readLines(rrna_file, warn = FALSE))
rrna_ids <- rrna_ids[nzchar(rrna_ids) & !startsWith(rrna_ids, "#")]
main_chromosome_ids <- placement$gene_id[
  placement$sequence_class == "Nuclear chromosome" &
    !placement$gene_id %in% rrna_ids
]
counts <- counts[intersect(rownames(counts), main_chromosome_ids), , drop = FALSE]
expressed_universe <- rownames(counts)[
  rowSums(counts >= params$min_count, na.rm = TRUE) >= params$min_samples
]
counts <- counts[expressed_universe, , drop = FALSE]

metadata <- read_metadata(metadata_file) |>
  dplyr::filter(label %in% colnames(counts)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(label, colnames(counts))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = factor(
      paste0("diet", Diet, "_", tolower(as.character(Treatment))),
      levels = c(
        "diet33_control", "diet50_control", "diet83_control",
        "diet33_infected", "diet50_infected", "diet83_infected"
      )
    )
  )
if (!setequal(metadata$label, colnames(counts))) {
  stop("Metadata and fresh competitive counts have different sample IDs.")
}
counts <- counts[, metadata$label, drop = FALSE]

dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = data.frame(
    group = metadata$group,
    row.names = metadata$label
  ),
  design = ~ 0 + group
)
dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(
  dds,
  minReplicatesForReplace = Inf,
  quiet = TRUE
)
vst_matrix <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(DESeq2::vst(dds, blind = TRUE))

primary_results <- readr::read_csv(primary_result_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    mapping_branch == "Competitive host",
    analysis_scope == "Placed/host-assigned",
    significant,
    gene_id %in% main_chromosome_ids,
    gene_id %in% rownames(vst_matrix)
  )
if (nrow(primary_results) == 0) {
  stop("No significant main-chromosome DEGs were found in the primary results.")
}

context_membership <- primary_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    context_family = dplyr::case_when(
      contrast_family == "Diet among controls" ~ "Diet in controls",
      contrast_family == "Diet among infected" ~ "Diet in infected",
      contrast_family %in% c(
        "Infection within diet",
        "Average infection response",
        "Diet by infection interaction"
      ) ~ "Infection within diet",
      TRUE ~ "Other fat body DEG"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene_id, context_family)

gene_context <- context_membership |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_context_families = dplyr::n_distinct(context_family),
    single_context = dplyr::first(context_family),
    DEG_context = dplyr::case_when(
      n_context_families > 1 ~ "Infection + diet",
      TRUE ~ single_context
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

full_heatmap_genes <- primary_results |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_deg_contrasts = dplyr::n_distinct(contrast_id),
    comparisons = paste(sort(unique(contrast_id)), collapse = "; "),
    directions = paste(sort(unique(higher_in)), collapse = "; "),
    max_abs_log2FC = max(abs(log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
    phase_class = "Not evaluated in this chromosome-only figure",
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_context, by = "gene_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gff_annotation |> dplyr::select(gene_id, Description),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description = dplyr::coalesce(Description, "no GFF description")
  )

full_heatmap_z_input <- vst_matrix[full_heatmap_genes$gene_id, , drop = FALSE]
full_heatmap_z_input <- t(scale(t(full_heatmap_z_input)))
keep_finite <- apply(full_heatmap_z_input, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))
full_heatmap_z_input <- full_heatmap_z_input[keep_finite, , drop = FALSE]
full_heatmap_genes <- full_heatmap_genes |>
  dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% rownames(full_heatmap_z_input))

sample_max_index <- max.col(abs(full_heatmap_z_input), ties.method = "first")
sample_diagnostics <- tibble::tibble(
  gene_id = rownames(full_heatmap_z_input),
  max_abs_sample_z = apply(abs(full_heatmap_z_input), 1, max),
  sample_with_max_abs_z = colnames(full_heatmap_z_input)[sample_max_index],
  sample_deviation_direction = dplyr::if_else(
    full_heatmap_z_input[cbind(seq_len(nrow(full_heatmap_z_input)), sample_max_index)] > 0,
    "Higher than gene mean",
    "Lower than gene mean"
  )
)
full_heatmap_genes <- full_heatmap_genes |>
  dplyr::left_join(sample_diagnostics, by = "gene_id")

row_distance <- stats::dist(full_heatmap_z_input)
row_tree <- stats::hclust(row_distance, method = "complete")
ordered_genes <- rownames(full_heatmap_z_input)[row_tree$order]
raw_cluster <- stats::cutree(row_tree, k = 4)[ordered_genes]
cluster_runs <- rle(raw_cluster)
row_cluster_spans <- data.frame(
  cluster_id = cluster_runs$values,
  start = cumsum(c(1L, head(cluster_runs$lengths, -1L))),
  end = cumsum(cluster_runs$lengths),
  n = cluster_runs$lengths
)
if (nrow(row_cluster_spans) != 4) {
  stop("The four-cluster tree did not produce four contiguous heatmap branches.")
}

full_heatmap_genes <- full_heatmap_genes |>
  dplyr::mutate(heatmap_row_order = match(gene_id, ordered_genes)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(heatmap_row_order)
full_heatmap_z_input <- full_heatmap_z_input[ordered_genes, , drop = FALSE]

full_heatmap_gene_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "full_main_chromosome_deg_diagnostic_heatmap_gene_order.csv"
)
full_heatmap_z_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "full_main_chromosome_deg_diagnostic_z_vst_matrix.csv.gz"
)
row_cluster_span_file <- file.path(out_dir, "row_cluster_spans_k4.csv")
write.csv(full_heatmap_genes, full_heatmap_gene_file, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(full_heatmap_z_input, gzfile(full_heatmap_z_file))
write.csv(row_cluster_spans, row_cluster_span_file, row.names = FALSE)

cluster_genes <- ordered_genes[raw_cluster == cluster_runs$values[[1]]]
circled_cluster <- full_heatmap_genes |>
  dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% cluster_genes)
full_deg_universe <- unique(full_heatmap_genes$gene_id)

set_summary <- data.frame(
  set = c("First main-chromosome expression branch",
          "All expressed main-chromosome genes",
          "Union of all significant main-chromosome fat body DEGs"),
  n_genes = c(length(cluster_genes), length(expressed_universe),
              length(full_deg_universe))
)

write.csv(set_summary, file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_set_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(set_summary, caption = "Gene sets used for enrichment")
```

## Enrichment tests

```{r run-enrichment}
maps <- load_term_maps()

maps$term2gene_go <- maps$term2gene_go |>
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% expressed_universe)
maps$term2gene_kegg <- maps$term2gene_kegg |>
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% expressed_universe)

backgrounds <- list(
  "Expressed rRNA-filtered genes" = expressed_universe,
  "All fat body DEGs in heatmap" = intersect(full_deg_universe, expressed_universe)
)

go_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(backgrounds), function(bg) {
  run_enrichment(
    genes = cluster_genes,
    universe = backgrounds[[bg]],
    term2gene = maps$term2gene_go,
    term2name = maps$term2name_go,
    database = "GO",
    background_label = bg
  )
}))

kegg_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(backgrounds), function(bg) {
  run_enrichment(
    genes = cluster_genes,
    universe = backgrounds[[bg]],
    term2gene = maps$term2gene_kegg,
    term2name = maps$term2name_kegg,
    database = "KEGG_pathway",
    background_label = bg
  )
}))

if (nrow(go_enrichment) > 0) {
  go_enrichment <- go_enrichment |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      maps$term2name_go |>
        dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          ID = term,
          ontology = dplyr::recode(
            ontology,
            BP = "Biological process",
            CC = "Cellular component",
            MF = "Molecular function",
            .default = NA_character_
          )
        ),
      by = "ID"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ontology))
}

if (nrow(kegg_enrichment) > 0) {
  kegg_enrichment <- kegg_enrichment |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      maps$term2name_kegg |>
        dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
        dplyr::transmute(ID = term, pathway_theme, pathway_scope),
      by = "ID"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway_theme = dplyr::coalesce(pathway_theme, "Other KEGG pathway"),
      pathway_scope = dplyr::coalesce(pathway_scope,
                                      "Unclassified KEGG reference label")
    )
}

all_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(go_enrichment, kegg_enrichment)
significant_enrichment <- all_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::arrange(database, background, p.adjust)

write.csv(go_enrichment,
          file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_GO_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(kegg_enrichment,
          file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_KEGG_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_enrichment,
          file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(significant_enrichment,
          file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_enrichment_significant_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

enrichment_count_summary <- significant_enrichment |>
  dplyr::count(database, background, name = "n_significant_terms") |>
  tidyr::complete(database = c("GO", "KEGG_pathway"),
                  background = names(backgrounds),
                  fill = list(n_significant_terms = 0)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(database, background)

write.csv(enrichment_count_summary,
          file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_enrichment_count_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(enrichment_count_summary,
             caption = "Significant enriched terms in the circled cluster")
```

## Expression-cluster landscape

The full diagnostic heatmap is first divided into four row branches from the
current gene-level dendrogram. The three-block display below keeps the earlier
publication layout by provisionally combining branches 3 and 4; it should be
treated as a visual review, not as the final clustering decision. The later
[full heatmap and gene-level cladogram](#Cluster_cladogram) preserve the original
tree continuously and provide the appropriate view for selecting new
boundaries. The lollipop panels summarize significant GO terms using all fat
body DEGs in the heatmap as the enrichment background.

```{r expression-cluster-landscape, fig.width=24, fig.height=26}
full_heatmap_z <- read.csv(gzfile(full_heatmap_z_file), check.names = FALSE,
                           row.names = 1)
full_heatmap_z <- as.matrix(full_heatmap_z)
storage.mode(full_heatmap_z) <- "numeric"

raw_sample_order <- colnames(full_heatmap_z)
sample_metadata <- read_metadata(metadata_file) |>
  dplyr::filter(label %in% raw_sample_order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    original_sample_index = match(label, raw_sample_order),
    Treatment_plot = factor(as.character(Treatment),
                            levels = c("Control", "Infected")),
    Diet_plot = factor(as.character(Diet), levels = c("33", "50", "83"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Treatment_plot, Diet_plot, original_sample_index)
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_index = dplyr::row_number(),
    sample_group = factor(
      paste(Treatment_plot, Diet_plot),
      levels = c("Control 33", "Control 50", "Control 83",
                 "Infected 33", "Infected 50", "Infected 83")
    ),
    outlier_status = dplyr::if_else(
      label %in% current_outliers,
      "Discussed outlier",
      "Other sample"
    )
  )
sample_order <- sample_metadata$label

row_cluster_spans <- read.csv(row_cluster_span_file, check.names = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::arrange(start) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    original_expression_cluster_order = dplyr::row_number(),
    original_expression_cluster = paste0(
      "Original branch ", original_expression_cluster_order,
      "\n(n = ", n, " genes)"
    ),
    expression_cluster_order = dplyr::case_when(
      original_expression_cluster_order %in% c(1, 2) ~ original_expression_cluster_order,
      original_expression_cluster_order %in% c(3, 4) ~ 3L
    )
  )

merged_cluster_spans <- row_cluster_spans |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster_order) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    start = min(start),
    end = max(end),
    n = sum(n),
    original_branches = paste(original_expression_cluster_order, collapse = "+"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expression_cluster = dplyr::case_when(
      expression_cluster_order == 1 ~ "DEG cluster 1",
      expression_cluster_order == 2 ~ "DEG cluster 2",
      expression_cluster_order == 3 ~ "DEG cluster 3+4"
    )
  )
cluster_levels <- merged_cluster_spans$expression_cluster
expression_cluster_colors <- stats::setNames(
  c("#315C8A", "#C85A54", "#2F8F5B"),
  cluster_levels
)
cluster_index <- findInterval(
  full_heatmap_genes$heatmap_row_order,
  row_cluster_spans$start
)
cluster_index <- pmin(pmax(cluster_index, 1), nrow(row_cluster_spans))
merged_cluster_index <- row_cluster_spans$expression_cluster_order[cluster_index]
merged_cluster_match <- match(
  merged_cluster_index,
  merged_cluster_spans$expression_cluster_order
)

deg_context_levels <- c(
  "Diet in controls",
  "Diet in infected",
  "Infection within diet",
  "Infection + diet",
  "Diet in controls + infected",
  "Other fat body DEG"
)
deg_context_labels <- c(
  "Diet in controls" = "Diet DEG in controls",
  "Diet in infected" = "Diet DEG in infected",
  "Infection within diet" = "Infected vs control within diet",
  "Infection + diet" = "Infection + diet DEG",
  "Diet in controls + infected" = "Diet DEG in controls + infected",
  "Other fat body DEG" = "Other fat body DEG"
)
deg_context_colors <- c(
  "Diet in controls" = "#DDE3EA",
  "Diet in infected" = "#AEBBC8",
  "Infection within diet" = "#7D8FA3",
  "Infection + diet" = "#4D6278",
  "Diet in controls + infected" = "#2F4052",
  "Other fat body DEG" = "#F2F4F6"
)
deg_context_plot_levels <- c(
  "~ diet (controls)",
  "~ diet (infected)",
  "~ diet + infection",
  "shared DEGs",
  "Other fat body DEG"
)
deg_context_plot_colors <- c(
  "~ diet (controls)" = "#DDE3EA",
  "~ diet (infected)" = "#AEBBC8",
  "~ diet + infection" = "#65788C",
  "shared DEGs" = "#263544",
  "Other fat body DEG" = "#F2F4F6"
)

expression_cluster_assignments <- full_heatmap_genes |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expression_cluster_order = merged_cluster_index,
    expression_cluster = factor(merged_cluster_spans$expression_cluster[merged_cluster_match],
                                levels = cluster_levels),
    original_expression_cluster_order =
      row_cluster_spans$original_expression_cluster_order[cluster_index],
    original_expression_cluster =
      row_cluster_spans$original_expression_cluster[cluster_index],
    original_pheatmap_cluster_id = row_cluster_spans$cluster_id[cluster_index],
    within_cluster_order = heatmap_row_order -
      merged_cluster_spans$start[merged_cluster_match] + 1,
    original_within_cluster_order = heatmap_row_order -
      row_cluster_spans$start[cluster_index] + 1,
    DEG_context = dplyr::coalesce(DEG_context, "Other fat body DEG"),
    DEG_context = dplyr::if_else(
      DEG_context %in% deg_context_levels,
      DEG_context,
      "Other fat body DEG"
    ),
    DEG_context = factor(DEG_context, levels = deg_context_levels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    expression_cluster_order,
    DEG_context,
    min_padj,
    dplyr::desc(max_abs_log2FC),
    original_within_cluster_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
  dplyr::mutate(within_cluster_order = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(heatmap_row_order, gene_id, expression_cluster_order,
                expression_cluster, original_expression_cluster_order,
                original_expression_cluster, original_pheatmap_cluster_id,
                within_cluster_order, original_within_cluster_order,
                Description, DEG_context, phase_class,
                n_deg_contrasts, comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC,
                min_padj, max_abs_sample_z, sample_with_max_abs_z,
                sample_deviation_direction)

write.csv(
  expression_cluster_assignments,
  file.path(out_dir, "full_heatmap_expression_cluster_assignments.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cluster_go_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cluster_levels, function(cl) {
  genes <- expression_cluster_assignments$gene_id[
    expression_cluster_assignments$expression_cluster == cl
  ]
  run_enrichment(
    genes = genes,
    universe = backgrounds[["All fat body DEGs in heatmap"]],
    term2gene = maps$term2gene_go,
    term2name = maps$term2name_go,
    database = "GO",
    background_label = "All fat body DEGs in heatmap"
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      expression_cluster = cl,
      n_cluster_genes = length(genes)
    )
}))

if (nrow(cluster_go_enrichment) > 0) {
  cluster_go_enrichment <- cluster_go_enrichment |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      maps$term2name_go |>
        dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          ID = term,
          ontology = dplyr::recode(
            ontology,
            BP = "Biological process",
            CC = "Cellular component",
            MF = "Molecular function",
            .default = NA_character_
          )
        ),
      by = "ID"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ontology)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster, levels = cluster_levels),
      ontology = factor(ontology, levels = names(go_ontology_colors))
    )
}

cluster_go_significant <- cluster_go_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, ontology, p.adjust)

cluster_go_summary <- cluster_go_significant |>
  dplyr::count(expression_cluster, ontology, name = "n_significant_terms") |>
  tidyr::complete(expression_cluster = factor(cluster_levels,
                                             levels = cluster_levels),
                  ontology = factor(names(go_ontology_colors),
                                    levels = names(go_ontology_colors)),
                  fill = list(n_significant_terms = 0)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, ontology)

write.csv(cluster_go_enrichment,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_GO_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cluster_go_significant,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_GO_enrichment_significant_terms.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cluster_go_summary,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_GO_enrichment_count_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cluster_gene_annotation <- expression_cluster_assignments |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id, DEG_context, phase_class, n_deg_contrasts,
                comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj) |>
  dplyr::left_join(

  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description = dplyr::coalesce(Description, "no GFF description"),
    gene_biotype = dplyr::coalesce(gene_biotype, "unknown")
  )

cluster_term_gene_long <- cluster_go_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::select(expression_cluster, database, background, ID, Description,
                GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, Count, geneID) |>

cluster_term_gene_compact <- cluster_term_gene_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster, database, background, term_id, term_name,
                  GeneRatio, BgRatio, p.adjust, Count) |>

    DEG_gene_descriptions = paste(sort(unique(Description)), collapse = "; "),
    DEG_contexts = paste(sort(unique(DEG_context)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, p.adjust)

write.csv(cluster_term_gene_long,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_GO_term_gene_index_long.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cluster_term_gene_compact,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_GO_term_gene_index_compact.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

sample_group_ranges <- sample_metadata |>
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment_plot, Diet_plot, sample_group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(start = min(sample_index), end = max(sample_index),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(Treatment_plot, Diet_plot)
sample_gaps <- sample_group_ranges$end[-nrow(sample_group_ranges)] + 0.5
treatment_gaps <- sample_group_ranges$end[
  which(as.character(sample_group_ranges$Treatment_plot[-nrow(sample_group_ranges)]) !=
          as.character(sample_group_ranges$Treatment_plot[-1]))
] + 0.5
diet_gaps <- setdiff(sample_gaps, treatment_gaps)

annotation_fill_colors <- c(
  "Treatment: Infected" = "#8B0000",
  "Treatment: Control" = "#FAEBD7",
  "Diet: 33" = "#E6862E",
  "Diet: 50" = "#2F8F5B",
  "Diet: 83" = "#7B4FA3"
)

sample_x_limits <- c(-1.25, length(sample_order) + 0.5)

sample_annotation_long <- sample_metadata |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_index,
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
    Diet = as.character(Diet)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Treatment, Diet),
    names_to = "track",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    track = factor(track, levels = c("Diet", "Treatment")),
    track_y = as.numeric(track),

  )

sample_annotation_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(

) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = diet_gaps, color = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.35) +

                      linewidth = 0.8) +

  ggplot2::theme(

    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 4, 0, 4)
  )

heatmap_z_plot <- full_heatmap_z[
  expression_cluster_assignments$gene_id,
  sample_order,
  drop = FALSE
]
heatmap_z_plot <- pmax(pmin(heatmap_z_plot, 3), -3)
heatmap_df <- as.data.frame(heatmap_z_plot, check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    expression_cluster_assignments |>

  ) |>

heatmap_colors <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#237C8E", "#F7F3E8", "#C85A54")
)(101)

gene_context_strip_df <- expression_cluster_assignments |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id, expression_cluster, within_cluster_order,

    ),

                              levels = deg_context_plot_levels)

prepare_lollipop_df <- function(tab, ontologies, n_terms,
                                terms_per_ontology = FALSE) {
  group_vars <- if (terms_per_ontology) {
    c("expression_cluster", "ontology")
  } else {
    "expression_cluster"
  }

  tab |>
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha, ontology %in% ontologies) |>
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) |>
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = n_terms, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, ontology, p.adjust) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      term_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 46),
      term_plot_id = paste(term_label, dplyr::row_number(),
                           expression_cluster, sep = "___")
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      term_plot_id = factor(term_plot_id, levels = rev(unique(term_plot_id))),
      expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster, levels = cluster_levels)
    )
}

clean_term_labels <- function(x) {
  labels <- sub("___.*$", "", x)
  dplyr::if_else(labels == "No significant GO terms", "", labels)
}

make_lollipop_plot <- function(plot_df, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0,
                          label = "No significant GO terms",
                          size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
      )
  }

  x_axis_max <- max(
    c(plot_df$neg_log10_padj, -log10(params$alpha)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  x_axis_limit <- x_axis_max + max(0.8, x_axis_max * 0.18)
  label_space <- x_axis_max * 2.4
  x_breaks <- pretty(c(0, x_axis_limit), n = 5)
  x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks >= 0 & x_breaks <= x_axis_limit]
  missing_label_x <- max(
    c(plot_df$neg_log10_padj, -log10(params$alpha)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) / 2
  missing_cluster_df <- tibble::tibble(
    expression_cluster = factor(
      setdiff(cluster_levels, as.character(unique(plot_df$expression_cluster))),
      levels = cluster_levels
    ),
    term_plot_id = "No significant GO terms",
    x = missing_label_x,
    label = "No significant GO terms"
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(expression_cluster))

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = term_plot_id)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "#9CA3AF",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = plot_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = -label_space * 0.98,
        y = term_plot_id,
        label = clean_term_labels(term_plot_id)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 5.2,
      lineheight = 0.84,
      color = "#111827"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = neg_log10_padj,
                   y = term_plot_id, yend = term_plot_id,
                   color = ontology),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = Count, color = ontology),
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = missing_cluster_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = term_plot_id, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      color = "#6B7280",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ expression_cluster, nrow = 1,
                        scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = go_ontology_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) rep("", length(x))) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-label_space, x_axis_limit),
      breaks = x_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(3.5, 9)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      color = "GO ontology",
      size = "Cluster genes in term"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black",
                                                 linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F3F4F6",
                                               color = "#9CA3AF"),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Unmerged four-branch review {#unmerged-four-branch-review .tabset}

The four branches below are the direct `k = 4` cut of the current
main-chromosome gene-expression dendrogram. No branches are merged in this
section. This is the appropriate table to review before deciding whether the
publication figure should retain four clusters, merge selected branches, or use
a different cut of the tree.

Enrichment is recomputed independently for each original branch against all
fat-body DEGs in the heatmap. A zero therefore means that no term passed the
adjusted p-value threshold for that branch and background. It does not mean
that the branch contains no annotated genes.

### Coverage and enrichment

```{r unmerged-k4-coverage-enrichment}
original_branch_levels <- paste("Branch", seq_len(nrow(row_cluster_spans)))

go_gene_counts <- maps$term2gene_go |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene) |>
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "n_GO_annotations")
kegg_gene_counts <- maps$term2gene_kegg |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene) |>
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "n_KEGG_annotations")

unmerged_gene_table <- expression_cluster_assignments |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    original_branch = factor(
      paste("Branch", original_expression_cluster_order),
      levels = original_branch_levels
    ),
    proposed_merged_cluster = as.character(expression_cluster)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gff_annotation |> dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_biotype),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(go_gene_counts, by = c("gene_id" = "gene")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(kegg_gene_counts, by = c("gene_id" = "gene")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene_biotype = dplyr::coalesce(gene_biotype, "unknown"),
    n_GO_annotations = dplyr::coalesce(n_GO_annotations, 0L),
    n_KEGG_annotations = dplyr::coalesce(n_KEGG_annotations, 0L)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(original_expression_cluster_order,
                 original_within_cluster_order) |>
  dplyr::select(
    heatmap_row_order, original_branch, original_pheatmap_cluster_id,
    original_within_cluster_order, proposed_merged_cluster,
    gene_id, Description, gene_biotype, DEG_context, n_deg_contrasts,
    comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj,
    max_abs_sample_z, sample_with_max_abs_z,
    sample_deviation_direction, n_GO_annotations, n_KEGG_annotations
  )

write.csv(
  unmerged_gene_table,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_full_gene_assignments.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

unmerged_go_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  original_branch_levels,
  function(branch) {
    genes <- unmerged_gene_table$gene_id[
      as.character(unmerged_gene_table$original_branch) == branch
    ]
    run_enrichment(
      genes = genes,
      universe = backgrounds[["All fat body DEGs in heatmap"]],
      term2gene = maps$term2gene_go,
      term2name = maps$term2name_go,
      database = "GO",
      background_label = "All fat body DEGs in heatmap"
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(original_branch = branch,
                    n_branch_genes = length(genes))
  }
)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    maps$term2name_go |>
      dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        ID = term,
        ontology = dplyr::recode(
          ontology,
          BP = "Biological process",
          CC = "Cellular component",
          MF = "Molecular function",
          .default = NA_character_
        )
      ),
    by = "ID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ontology))

unmerged_kegg_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  original_branch_levels,
  function(branch) {
    genes <- unmerged_gene_table$gene_id[
      as.character(unmerged_gene_table$original_branch) == branch
    ]
    run_enrichment(
      genes = genes,
      universe = backgrounds[["All fat body DEGs in heatmap"]],
      term2gene = maps$term2gene_kegg,
      term2name = maps$term2name_kegg,
      database = "KEGG_pathway",
      background_label = "All fat body DEGs in heatmap"
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(original_branch = branch,
                    n_branch_genes = length(genes))
  }
))

unmerged_go_significant <- unmerged_go_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::arrange(original_branch, ontology, p.adjust)
unmerged_kegg_significant <- unmerged_kegg_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::arrange(original_branch, p.adjust)

write.csv(
  unmerged_go_enrichment,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_GO_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  unmerged_go_significant,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_GO_enrichment_significant_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  unmerged_kegg_enrichment,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_KEGG_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  unmerged_kegg_significant,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_KEGG_enrichment_significant_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

branch_coverage <- unmerged_gene_table |>
  dplyr::group_by(original_branch) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genes = dplyr::n(),
    n_with_GFF_description = sum(Description != "no GFF description"),
    n_with_GO = sum(n_GO_annotations > 0),
    percent_with_GO = round(100 * n_with_GO / n_genes, 1),
    n_with_KEGG = sum(n_KEGG_annotations > 0),
    percent_with_KEGG = round(100 * n_with_KEGG / n_genes, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

branch_go_counts <- unmerged_go_significant |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ontology_code = dplyr::recode(
      ontology,
      "Biological process" = "BP",
      "Cellular component" = "CC",
      "Molecular function" = "MF"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(original_branch, ontology_code, name = "n_terms") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    original_branch = original_branch_levels,
    ontology_code = c("BP", "CC", "MF"),
    fill = list(n_terms = 0)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = ontology_code,
    values_from = n_terms,
    names_prefix = "significant_GO_"
  )

branch_kegg_counts <- unmerged_kegg_significant |>
  dplyr::count(original_branch, name = "significant_KEGG_pathways") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    original_branch = original_branch_levels,
    fill = list(significant_KEGG_pathways = 0)
  )

unmerged_branch_summary <- branch_coverage |>
  dplyr::mutate(original_branch = as.character(original_branch)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(branch_go_counts, by = "original_branch") |>
  dplyr::left_join(branch_kegg_counts, by = "original_branch") |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(original_branch, original_branch_levels))

write.csv(
  unmerged_branch_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "unmerged_k4_annotation_enrichment_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  unmerged_branch_summary,
  caption = paste0(
    "Annotation coverage and significant enrichment for the four unmerged ",
    "branches; adjusted p-value <= ", params$alpha
  )
)
```

## Combined GO and KEGG figure

The main figure below keeps the full gene-by-sample heatmap so every DEG in the
circled branch remains visible, then summarizes GO terms and KEGG pathways for
the same expression clusters. KEGG terms are eggNOG-linked `ko` reference
pathways, not insect-only organism pathways. The pathway-scope category is kept
in the exported KEGG tables, but panel C uses one brown color so the pathway
labels remain visually simple. The code also exports optional
per-sample and treatment-average cluster-score summaries as secondary diagnostic
files.

### DEG context annotation in panel A

The `DEG context` strip on the left of panel A is a contrast-family annotation.
It tells which type of DESeq2 contrast detected each gene as significant before
the heatmap was clustered. These labels are useful for reading the heatmap, but
they should not be interpreted as mutually exclusive biological mechanisms.

`~ diet (controls)` means the gene was significant in diet comparisons among
control animals only, for example control 33 vs 50, 83 vs 33, or 83 vs 50. This
is the closest label to a baseline diet effect without infection.

`~ diet (infected)` means the gene was significant in diet comparisons among
infected animals only. This asks whether infected animals on different diets
have different expression.

`~ diet + infection` means the gene was significant when infected and
control animals were compared within at least one diet. This is the most direct
infection-response label in this heatmap, but the comparison is diet-stratified,
so the label keeps both diet and infection in view.

`shared DEGs` means the gene was detected in more than one contrast family. This
combines genes that were diet-associated in both control and infected
backgrounds, and genes that were detected in both infection and diet contrast
families. It is an overlap label and does not by itself prove a formal
diet-by-infection interaction.

`Other fat body DEG` is a fallback category for genes in the full fat-body DEG
heatmap that do not fall cleanly into the simplified contrast families above. It
is retained in the code for completeness, but it may not appear in every figure.

```{r expression-cluster-treatment-summary, fig.width=18, fig.height=18}
cluster_sample_scores <- heatmap_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster, sample_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(cluster_mean_z = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(label, Treatment, Diet, sample_group, outlier_status),
    by = c("sample_id" = "label")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster, levels = cluster_levels),
    sample_group = factor(sample_group,
                          levels = unique(sample_metadata$sample_group)),
    sample_label = dplyr::if_else(
      outlier_status == "Discussed outlier",
      paste0(sample_id, " *"),
      sample_id
    ),
    sample_label = factor(
      sample_label,
      levels = rev(dplyr::if_else(
        sample_metadata$outlier_status == "Discussed outlier",
        paste0(sample_metadata$label, " *"),
        sample_metadata$label
      ))
    )
  )

treatment_cluster_summary <- cluster_sample_scores |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster, Treatment, Diet, sample_group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = dplyr::n(),
    mean_z = mean(cluster_mean_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_z = stats::sd(cluster_mean_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_z = sd_z / sqrt(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_group_plot = factor(sample_group,
                               levels = rev(unique(sample_metadata$sample_group))),
    tile_label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_z)
  )

write.csv(cluster_sample_scores,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_sample_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(treatment_cluster_summary,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "expression_cluster_treatment_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

sample_cluster_heatmap_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cluster_sample_scores,
  ggplot2::aes(x = expression_cluster, y = sample_label, fill = cluster_mean_z)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(sample_group ~ ., scales = "free_y",
                      space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = heatmap_colors,
    limits = c(-2, 2),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Sample cluster\nscore"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "A. Sample-level cluster expression heatmap",

                                              size = 11),

    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )

prepare_kegg_lollipop_df <- function(tab, n_terms) {
  tab |>
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = n_terms, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, pathway_theme, p.adjust) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      pathway_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 34),
      pathway_plot_id = paste(pathway_label, dplyr::row_number(),
                              expression_cluster, sep = "___")
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway_plot_id = factor(pathway_plot_id,
                               levels = rev(unique(pathway_plot_id))),
      expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster, levels = cluster_levels)
    )
}

clean_kegg_labels <- function(x) {
  labels <- sub("___.*$", "", x)
  dplyr::if_else(labels == "No significant KEGG pathways", "", labels)
}

make_kegg_lollipop_plot <- function(plot_df, title, subtitle = NULL) {
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0,
                          label = "No significant KEGG pathways",
                          size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
      )
  }

  x_axis_max <- max(
    c(plot_df$neg_log10_padj, -log10(params$alpha)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  x_axis_limit <- x_axis_max + max(0.8, x_axis_max * 0.18)
  label_space <- x_axis_max * 2.4
  x_breaks <- pretty(c(0, x_axis_limit), n = 5)
  x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks >= 0 & x_breaks <= x_axis_limit]
  missing_label_x <- max(
    c(plot_df$neg_log10_padj, -log10(params$alpha)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) / 2
  missing_cluster_df <- tibble::tibble(
    expression_cluster = factor(
      setdiff(cluster_levels, as.character(unique(plot_df$expression_cluster))),
      levels = cluster_levels
    ),
    pathway_plot_id = "No significant KEGG pathways",
    x = missing_label_x,
    label = "No significant KEGG pathways"
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(expression_cluster))

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = pathway_plot_id)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "#9CA3AF",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = plot_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = -label_space * 0.98,
        y = pathway_plot_id,
        label = clean_kegg_labels(pathway_plot_id)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      size = 5.2,
      lineheight = 0.84,
      color = "#111827"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = neg_log10_padj,
                   y = pathway_plot_id, yend = pathway_plot_id),
      color = kegg_lollipop_color,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.78
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = Count),
      color = kegg_lollipop_color,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = missing_cluster_df,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = pathway_plot_id, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4,
      color = "#6B7280",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ expression_cluster, nrow = 1,
                        scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) rep("", length(x))) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-label_space, x_axis_limit),
      breaks = x_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 10)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      size = "Cluster genes in pathway"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black",
                                                 linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F3F4F6",
                                               color = "#9CA3AF"),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

kegg_lollipop_df <- prepare_kegg_lollipop_df(
  cluster_kegg_significant,
  n_terms = 8
)
kegg_lollipop_plot <- make_kegg_lollipop_plot(

)

  )
```

## Composite with reference tissues

This companion composite keeps the same fat-body DEG rows as panel A above, but
adds VST expression columns for the available reference samples: the two
time-course FAT phase controls and the copied head/thorax phase-reference
samples. These reference samples are not used to call the DEGs in this figure;
they are shown only to ask whether the fat-body DEG clusters also have visible
expression structure in other tissues or in the independent FAT controls.

```{r expression-cluster-reference-composite, fig.width=24, fig.height=22}
timecourse_reference_metadata <- file.path(
  timecourse_fatbody_dir,
  "gregaria_FAT_phase_reference_metadata.csv"
)

timecourse_ref_meta <- if (file.exists(timecourse_reference_metadata)) {
  read.csv(timecourse_reference_metadata, check.names = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      count_file = file.path(timecourse_fatbody_dir, "readcounts", file_name),
      file_present = file.exists(count_file)
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

head_thorax_ref_meta <- parse_head_thorax_reference_metadata(
  timecourse_head_thorax_dir
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(file_present = file.exists(count_file))

fatbody_ref_meta <- if (nrow(timecourse_ref_meta) > 0) {
  timecourse_ref_meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      tissue = "Fat body",
      source = "Time-course fat body phase control",
      display_group = dplyr::case_when(
        phase == "Gregarious" ~ "Fat body: gregarious/crowded control",
        phase == "Solitarious" ~ "Fat body: solitarious/isolated control",
        TRUE ~ "Fat body: reference control"
      ),
      sample_label = dplyr::case_when(
        phase == "Gregarious" ~ "FAT-G",
        phase == "Solitarious" ~ "FAT-S",
        TRUE ~ sample_id
      ),
      sample_block = "FAT controls",
      treatment_or_phase = phase,
      diet = "Reference"
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      sample_id, count_file, tissue, phase, rearing_condition, replicate,
      source, display_group, reference_role, sample_label, sample_block,
      treatment_or_phase, diet, file_present
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

head_thorax_ref_meta <- head_thorax_ref_meta |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment_or_phase = phase,
    diet = "Reference"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id, count_file, tissue, phase, rearing_condition, replicate,
    source, display_group, reference_role, sample_label, sample_block,
    treatment_or_phase, diet, file_present
  )

reference_manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  fatbody_ref_meta,
  head_thorax_ref_meta
)

reference_inputs <- reference_manifest |>
  dplyr::count(sample_block, tissue, treatment_or_phase, file_present,
               name = "n_samples")
knitr::kable(
  reference_inputs,
  caption = "Reference samples available for the expanded panel A"
)

reference_ready <- nrow(reference_manifest) > 0 &&
  all(reference_manifest$file_present)

if (reference_ready) {
  # Reuse the audited, expressed main-chromosome matrix built above.
  experiment_counts <- counts
  experiment_counts <- experiment_counts[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

  experiment_reference_meta <- sample_metadata |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      sample_id = label,
      count_file = NA_character_,
      tissue = "Fat body",
      phase = "Diet-infection experiment",
      rearing_condition = "Semi-isolated experiment",
      replicate = NA_integer_,
      source = "Diet-infection fat body experiment",
      display_group = paste(Treatment, Diet, sep = "_"),
      reference_role = paste("Fat body", Treatment, "diet", Diet),
      sample_label = label,
      sample_block = "Experiment fat body",
      treatment_or_phase = as.character(Treatment),
      diet = as.character(Diet),
      file_present = TRUE
    )

  reference_manifest <- reference_manifest |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_block = factor(
        sample_block,
        levels = c("FAT controls", "Head reference", "Thorax reference")
      ),
      tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Fat body", "Head", "Thorax")),
      treatment_or_phase = factor(
        treatment_or_phase,
        levels = c("Control", "Infected", "Gregarious", "Solitarious")
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(sample_block, tissue, treatment_or_phase, replicate)

  combined_reference_meta <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    experiment_reference_meta,
    reference_manifest
  )

  reference_count_tables <- Map(
    read_featurecounts_gene_counts,
    reference_manifest$count_file,
    reference_manifest$sample_id
  )
  reference_counts_df <- Reduce(
    function(x, y) dplyr::full_join(x, y, by = "gene_id"),
    reference_count_tables
  )
  reference_counts <- as.matrix(reference_counts_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(reference_counts) <- reference_counts_df$gene_id
  reference_counts[is.na(reference_counts)] <- 0L
  storage.mode(reference_counts) <- "integer"

  shared_reference_genes <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    list(rownames(experiment_counts), rownames(reference_counts))
  )

  combined_counts <- cbind(
    experiment_counts[shared_reference_genes, , drop = FALSE],
    reference_counts[
      shared_reference_genes,
      reference_manifest$sample_id,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )

  combined_reference_meta <- combined_reference_meta[
    match(colnames(combined_counts), combined_reference_meta$sample_id),
  ]
  combined_reference_meta$sample_block <- factor(
    combined_reference_meta$sample_block,
    levels = c(
      "Experiment fat body",
      "FAT controls",
      "Head reference",
      "Thorax reference"
    )
  )
  combined_reference_meta$tissue <- factor(
    combined_reference_meta$tissue,
    levels = c("Fat body", "Head", "Thorax")
  )
  combined_reference_meta$treatment_or_phase <- factor(
    combined_reference_meta$treatment_or_phase,
    levels = c("Control", "Infected", "Gregarious", "Solitarious")
  )
  combined_reference_meta$diet <- factor(
    combined_reference_meta$diet,
    levels = c("33", "50", "83", "Reference")
  )
  rownames(combined_reference_meta) <- combined_reference_meta$sample_id

  keep_reference <- rowSums(combined_counts >= params$min_count) >= params$min_samples
  dds_reference <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = combined_counts[keep_reference, , drop = FALSE],
    colData = as.data.frame(combined_reference_meta),
    design = ~ 1
  )
  vst_reference <- DESeq2::vst(dds_reference, blind = TRUE)
  vst_reference_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vst_reference)

  reference_gene_table <- expression_cluster_assignments |>
    dplyr::filter(gene_id %in% rownames(vst_reference_mat)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster_order, within_cluster_order) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::mutate(reference_within_cluster_order = dplyr::row_number()) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  reference_sample_order <- combined_reference_meta$sample_id
  reference_heatmap_z <- vst_reference_mat[
    reference_gene_table$gene_id,
    reference_sample_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  reference_heatmap_z <- t(scale(t(reference_heatmap_z)))
  reference_heatmap_z[is.na(reference_heatmap_z)] <- 0
  reference_heatmap_z <- pmax(pmin(reference_heatmap_z, 3), -3)

  reference_sample_metadata <- combined_reference_meta |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id_check") |>
    dplyr::select(-sample_id_check) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_index = dplyr::row_number(),
      sample_group_key = paste(sample_block, treatment_or_phase, diet, sep = "|")
    )

  reference_sample_ranges <- reference_sample_metadata |>
    dplyr::group_by(sample_group_key, sample_block) |>
    dplyr::summarise(start = min(sample_index), end = max(sample_index),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(start)
  reference_group_gaps <- reference_sample_ranges$end[
    -nrow(reference_sample_ranges)
  ] + 0.5
  reference_block_gaps <- reference_sample_ranges$end[
    which(
      as.character(reference_sample_ranges$sample_block[-nrow(reference_sample_ranges)]) !=
        as.character(reference_sample_ranges$sample_block[-1])
    )
  ] + 0.5
  reference_group_gaps <- setdiff(reference_group_gaps, reference_block_gaps)

  reference_annotation_colors <- c(
    "Tissue: Fat body" = "#D9A441",
    "Tissue: Head" = "#009E9A",
    "Tissue: Thorax" = "#C51B7D",
    "Diet: 33" = "#E6862E",
    "Diet: 50" = "#2F8F5B",
    "Diet: 83" = "#7B4FA3",
    "Diet: Reference" = "#D1D5DB",
    "State: Control" = "#FAEBD7",
    "State: Infected" = "#8B0000",
    "State: Gregarious" = "#111827",
    "State: Solitarious" = "#6B7280"
  )

  reference_annotation_long <- reference_sample_metadata |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      sample_index,
      Tissue = as.character(tissue),
      Diet = as.character(diet),
      State = as.character(treatment_or_phase)
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Tissue, Diet, State),
      names_to = "track",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      track = factor(track, levels = c("Tissue", "Diet", "State")),
      track_y = as.numeric(track),
      fill_key = paste(track, value, sep = ": ")
    )

  reference_x_limits <- c(-1.25, length(reference_sample_order) + 0.5)

  reference_sample_annotation_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    reference_annotation_long,
    ggplot2::aes(x = sample_index, y = track_y, fill = fill_key)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(width = 0.95, height = 0.9) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = reference_group_gaps,
                        color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = reference_block_gaps,
                        color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = reference_annotation_colors,
                               drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = reference_x_limits,
      breaks = reference_sample_metadata$sample_index,
      labels = reference_sample_metadata$sample_label,
      expand = c(0, 0),
      position = "top"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(3),
      labels = c("Tissue", "Diet", "State"),
      limits = c(0.45, 3.55),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Sample annotation") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    )

  reference_gene_context_strip_df <- reference_gene_table |>
    dplyr::select(gene_id, expression_cluster, reference_within_cluster_order,
                  DEG_context) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      DEG_context_plot = dplyr::case_when(
        DEG_context == "Diet in controls" ~ "~ diet (controls)",
        DEG_context == "Diet in infected" ~ "~ diet (infected)",
        DEG_context == "Infection within diet" ~ "~ diet + infection",
        DEG_context %in% c("Infection + diet",
                           "Diet in controls + infected") ~ "shared DEGs",
        TRUE ~ "Other fat body DEG"
      ),
      DEG_context_plot = factor(DEG_context_plot,
                                levels = deg_context_plot_levels)
    )
  present_reference_deg_context_levels <- deg_context_plot_levels[
    deg_context_plot_levels %in%
      as.character(reference_gene_context_strip_df$DEG_context_plot)
  ]
  present_reference_deg_context_labels <- stringr::str_wrap(
    present_reference_deg_context_levels,
    width = 26
  )

  reference_heatmap_df <- as.data.frame(reference_heatmap_z,
                                        check.names = FALSE) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      reference_gene_table |>
        dplyr::select(gene_id, expression_cluster,
                      reference_within_cluster_order),
      by = "gene_id"
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::all_of(reference_sample_order),
      names_to = "sample_id",
      values_to = "z"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample_index = match(sample_id, reference_sample_order))

  reference_cluster_heatmap_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    reference_heatmap_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = sample_index, y = reference_within_cluster_order,
                 fill = z)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = reference_gene_context_strip_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = -1.1,
        xend = 0.35,
        y = reference_within_cluster_order,
        yend = reference_within_cluster_order,
        color = DEG_context_plot
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1.05,
      lineend = "butt"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_raster() +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "#9CA3AF",
                        linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = reference_group_gaps,
                        color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = reference_block_gaps,
                        color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(expression_cluster ~ ., scales = "free_y",
                        switch = "y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = heatmap_colors,
      limits = c(-3, 3),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Row z-score"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = deg_context_plot_colors,
      breaks = present_reference_deg_context_levels,
      labels = present_reference_deg_context_labels,
      drop = TRUE,
      name = "DEG context"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = reference_x_limits,
      breaks = reference_sample_metadata$sample_index,
      labels = reference_sample_metadata$sample_label,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = "A. Fat body DEG expression landscape with reference tissues",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Rows are ", nrow(reference_gene_table),
        " fat-body DEGs; head, thorax, and FAT references are VST context columns"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,
                                          vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.background.y = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F3F4F6",
                                                 color = "#9CA3AF"),
      strip.text.y.left = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold",
                                                size = 13),
      panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.25, "lines"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      fill = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
        order = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        barheight = grid::unit(3.0, "cm"),
        barwidth = grid::unit(0.35, "cm")
      ),
      color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        title.position = "top",
        override.aes = list(linewidth = 3)
      )
    )

  reference_gene_level_GO_KEGG_figure <- reference_sample_annotation_plot /
    reference_cluster_heatmap_plot /
    go_lollipop_plot /
    kegg_lollipop_plot +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.05, 6.8, 5.6, 3.7)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = "Fat body DEG expression clusters with reference tissues",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "DEGs were called only in the fat body diet-infection experiment; ",
        "reference columns show VST row-z-scores for context"
      )
    )

  print(reference_gene_level_GO_KEGG_figure)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir,
              "expression_cluster_gene_level_GO_KEGG_lollipop_with_references.png"),
    reference_gene_level_GO_KEGG_figure,
    width = 24,
    height = 22,
    dpi = 220
  )
  grDevices::svg(
    file.path(out_dir,
              "expression_cluster_gene_level_GO_KEGG_lollipop_with_references.svg"),
    width = 24,
    height = 22,
    onefile = FALSE
  )
  print(reference_gene_level_GO_KEGG_figure)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir,
              "expression_cluster_reference_panel_A_heatmap.png"),
    reference_sample_annotation_plot / reference_cluster_heatmap_plot +
      patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.05, 6.8)),
    width = 24,
    height = 11,
    dpi = 260
  )

  write.csv(
    reference_gene_table,
    file.path(out_dir,
              "expression_cluster_reference_panel_A_genes.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    combined_reference_meta,
    file.path(out_dir,
              "expression_cluster_reference_panel_A_samples.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
} else {
  message("Reference composite skipped because one or more reference count files are missing.")
}
```

## Full heatmap and gene-level cladogram {#Cluster_cladogram}

This is the re-delimitation workspace. It contains every significant
main-chromosome DEG in the current all-samples analysis and does **not** draw any
provisional cluster boundaries. The dendrogram and heatmap are generated from
the same row-z-scored VST matrix, the same complete-linkage tree, and the same
leaf order. Thus, a branch seen in the tree aligns exactly with the genes on the
same horizontal band of the heatmap. The tree describes expression-profile
similarity; it is not a phylogeny.

```{r canonical-full-gene-tree-heatmap, fig.width=30, fig.height=24}
canonical_gene_dendro <- ggdendro::dendro_data(
  stats::as.dendrogram(row_tree),
  type = "rectangle"
)

canonical_gene_leaves <- ggdendro::label(canonical_gene_dendro) |>
  dplyr::rename(gene_id = label, leaf_x = x, leaf_y = y) |>
  dplyr::arrange(leaf_x) |>
  dplyr::mutate(canonical_gene_order = dplyr::row_number())

canonical_order_check <- data.frame(
  check = "Gene-level dendrogram leaf order matches the clustered heatmap order",
  value = identical(canonical_gene_leaves$gene_id, ordered_genes)
)
if (!canonical_order_check$value) {
  stop("Canonical dendrogram leaves do not match the clustered heatmap order.")
}

canonical_gene_table <- canonical_gene_leaves |>
  dplyr::select(canonical_gene_order, gene_id) |>
  dplyr::left_join(unmerged_gene_table, by = "gene_id") |>
  dplyr::arrange(canonical_gene_order)

write.csv(
  canonical_gene_table,
  file.path(out_dir, "full_heatmap_canonical_gene_order.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  canonical_order_check,
  file.path(out_dir, "full_heatmap_canonical_order_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

canonical_gene_order <- canonical_gene_leaves$gene_id
canonical_heatmap_matrix <- full_heatmap_z_input[
  canonical_gene_order,
  sample_order,
  drop = FALSE
]
canonical_heatmap_matrix <- pmax(pmin(canonical_heatmap_matrix, 3), -3)

canonical_heatmap_df <- as.data.frame(
  canonical_heatmap_matrix,
  check.names = FALSE
) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(gene_y = match(gene_id, canonical_gene_order)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(sample_order),
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "z"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(sample_index = match(sample_id, sample_order))

n_canonical_genes <- length(canonical_gene_order)
canonical_y_limits <- c(n_canonical_genes + 0.5, 0.5)

canonical_tree_segments <- ggdendro::segment(canonical_gene_dendro) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    tree_x = y,
    gene_y = x,
    tree_xend = yend,
    gene_yend = xend
  )

canonical_vertical_tree_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  canonical_tree_segments,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = tree_x,
    y = gene_y,
    xend = tree_xend,
    yend = gene_yend
```
