```{r canonical-full-gene-tree-heatmap, fig.width=30, fig.height=24}
) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(linewidth = 0.14, color = "#263241",
                        lineend = "square") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_reverse(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(limits = canonical_y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Tree height", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 3, 3)
  )

canonical_heatmap_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  canonical_heatmap_df,
  ggplot2::aes(x = sample_index, y = gene_y, fill = z)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = diet_gaps, color = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = treatment_gaps, color = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = heatmap_colors,
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Row z-score"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, length(sample_order) + 0.5),
    breaks = sample_metadata$sample_index,
    labels = sample_metadata$label,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(limits = canonical_y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,
                                        vjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 4, 3, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "top",

canonical_sample_annotation_plot <- sample_annotation_plot +

    limits = c(0.5, length(sample_order) + 0.5),

  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Full main-chromosome DEG heatmap with aligned gene dendrogram (",
      n_canonical_genes, " genes)"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

canonical_tree_column <- (
  patchwork::plot_spacer() /
    canonical_vertical_tree_plot
) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 12))
canonical_heatmap_column <- (
  canonical_sample_annotation_plot /
    canonical_heatmap_plot
) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 12))

canonical_tree_heatmap_figure <- (
  canonical_tree_column | canonical_heatmap_column
) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(3.8, 22))

print(canonical_tree_heatmap_figure)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "full_canonical_gene_tree_heatmap.png"),

ggplot2::ggsave(
```

### Full unpartitioned cladogram

defensible branch boundaries before rerunning enrichment.

### Proposed delimitations {.tabset}

The three tabs below apply candidate cuts at `k = 2`, `k = 3`, and `k = 4`
to the same complete-linkage tree. The dashed vertical line marks the cut height
on the dendrogram. The colored strip and horizontal boundaries identify the
resulting contiguous gene blocks on the heatmap. Cluster numbers follow the
top-to-bottom heatmap order and are only provisional labels.

```{r build-candidate-cut-figures, results='hide'}
candidate_cut_palette <- c(
  "Candidate cluster 1" = "#315C8A",
  "Candidate cluster 2" = "#C85A54",
  "Candidate cluster 3" = "#2F8F5B",
  "Candidate cluster 4" = "#D49A2A"
)

candidate_cut_height <- function(tree, k) {
  lower_index <- length(tree$height) - k + 1L
  mean(tree$height[c(lower_index, lower_index + 1L)])
}

build_candidate_cut_figure <- function(k) {
  raw_membership <- stats::cutree(row_tree, k = k)[canonical_gene_order]
  top_to_bottom_ids <- unique(raw_membership)
  display_membership <- match(raw_membership, top_to_bottom_ids)
  display_levels <- paste("Candidate cluster", seq_len(k))

  membership_df <- tibble::tibble(
    gene_id = canonical_gene_order,
    gene_y = seq_along(canonical_gene_order),
    candidate_cluster_number = display_membership,
    candidate_cluster = factor(
      paste("Candidate cluster", display_membership),
      levels = display_levels
    )
  )

  membership_runs <- rle(display_membership)
  if (length(membership_runs$lengths) != k) {
    stop("Candidate tree cut did not produce contiguous heatmap branches for k = ", k)
  }
  branch_ends <- cumsum(membership_runs$lengths)
  branch_starts <- c(1L, head(branch_ends, -1L) + 1L)
  branch_spans <- tibble::tibble(
    k = k,
    candidate_cluster_number = seq_len(k),
    candidate_cluster = factor(display_levels, levels = display_levels),
    start = branch_starts,
    end = branch_ends,
    midpoint = (branch_starts + branch_ends) / 2,
    n_genes = membership_runs$lengths
  )
  boundaries <- head(branch_ends, -1L) + 0.5
  cut_height <- candidate_cut_height(row_tree, k)

  candidate_tree_plot <- canonical_vertical_tree_plot +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = cut_height,
      color = "#8B0000",
      linetype = "22",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = boundaries,
      color = "#111827",
      linewidth = 0.35
    )

  candidate_strip_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    membership_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = 1, y = gene_y, fill = candidate_cluster)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(width = 0.92, height = 1) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = boundaries,
      color = "#111827",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = branch_spans,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = 1,
        y = midpoint,
        label = paste0("C", candidate_cluster_number, "\n", n_genes, " genes")
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "#111827",
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.2,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.14, "lines")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = candidate_cut_palette[display_levels],
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.5, 1.5),
      breaks = 1,
      labels = paste0("k = ", k),
      position = "top",
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(limits = canonical_y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 2, 3, 2)
    )

  candidate_heatmap_plot <- canonical_heatmap_plot +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = boundaries,
      color = "#111827",
      linewidth = 0.8
    )

  candidate_annotation_plot <- canonical_sample_annotation_plot +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Candidate k = ", k, " delimitation of ",
        n_canonical_genes, " main-chromosome DEGs"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Dashed tree line = cut height ", round(cut_height, 2),
        "; heatmap boundaries follow the resulting branches"
      )
    )

  tree_column <- (
    patchwork::plot_spacer() /
      candidate_tree_plot
  ) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 12))
  strip_column <- (
    patchwork::plot_spacer() /
      candidate_strip_plot
  ) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 12))
  heatmap_column <- (
    candidate_annotation_plot /
      candidate_heatmap_plot
  ) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.0, 12))

  figure <- (
    tree_column | strip_column | heatmap_column
  ) + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(3.8, 2.0, 22))

  list(
    figure = figure,
    membership = membership_df,
    spans = branch_spans,
    boundaries = boundaries,
    cut_height = cut_height
  )
}

candidate_cut_results <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(2:4, build_candidate_cut_figure),
  as.character(2:4)
)

candidate_assignment_table <- canonical_gene_table |>
  dplyr::select(canonical_gene_order, gene_id, Description, gene_biotype,
                DEG_context, comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj)
for (k in 2:4) {
  candidate_assignment_table[[paste0("candidate_k", k)]] <-
    as.character(candidate_cut_results[[as.character(k)]]$membership$candidate_cluster)
}
candidate_cut_span_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  candidate_cut_results,
  function(x) x$spans
))

write.csv(
  candidate_assignment_table,
  file.path(out_dir, "candidate_k2_k3_k4_gene_assignments.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  candidate_cut_span_table,
  file.path(out_dir, "candidate_k2_k3_k4_branch_spans.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

for (k in 2:4) {
  candidate_result <- candidate_cut_results[[as.character(k)]]
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("candidate_k", k, "_gene_tree_heatmap.png")),
    candidate_result$figure,
    width = 32,
    height = 24,
    dpi = 260,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("candidate_k", k, "_gene_tree_heatmap.pdf")),
    candidate_result$figure,
    width = 32,
    height = 24,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}
```

### Candidate tree cuts

These diagnostics compare several possible horizontal cuts of the same tree.
The silhouette score summarizes expression cohesion and separation, while the
branch sizes reveal whether a solution is dominated by very small groups. They
are decision aids, not an automatic biological definition of a cluster.

```{r candidate-tree-cut-diagnostics}
candidate_k_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(2:10, function(k) {
  memberships <- stats::cutree(row_tree, k = k)
  branch_sizes <- sort(table(memberships), decreasing = TRUE)
  silhouette_values <- cluster::silhouette(memberships, row_distance)[, "sil_width"]
  tibble::tibble(
    k = k,
    mean_silhouette = mean(silhouette_values),
    median_silhouette = stats::median(silhouette_values),
    smallest_branch = min(branch_sizes),
    largest_branch = max(branch_sizes),
    branch_sizes = paste(branch_sizes, collapse = "; ")
  )
}))

write.csv(
  candidate_k_diagnostics,
  file.path(out_dir, "candidate_tree_cut_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  candidate_k_diagnostics,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Candidate cuts of the full main-chromosome DEG expression tree"
)
```

## Primary two-cluster GO enrichment

The primary interpretation keeps every DEG in the statistically strongest
`k = 2` division. The narrow subbranches visible inside the two large blocks are
not removed: they are coherent parts of the expression tree and may represent
real specialized responses. Removing them solely because they look unusual
would make the enrichment dependent on visual judgement.

Three foregrounds are tested independently against the same expressed,
rRNA-filtered main-chromosome background:

1. all significant main-chromosome DEGs, to summarize the overall response;
2. candidate expression cluster 1;
3. candidate expression cluster 2.

The 71- and 45-gene subbranches from the `k = 4` view remain nested within these
two primary clusters. Their separate enrichment can be used later as a
sensitivity analysis without changing the primary gene sets.

```{r primary-k2-go-enrichment, fig.width=36, fig.height=24}
k2_membership <- candidate_cut_results[["2"]]$membership
primary_k2_set_levels <- c(
  "All main-chromosome DEGs",
  "Expression cluster 1",
  "Expression cluster 2"
)
primary_k2_gene_sets <- list(
  "All main-chromosome DEGs" = canonical_gene_order,
  "Expression cluster 1" = k2_membership$gene_id[
    k2_membership$candidate_cluster == "Candidate cluster 1"
  ],
  "Expression cluster 2" = k2_membership$gene_id[
    k2_membership$candidate_cluster == "Candidate cluster 2"
  ]
)

go_annotated_genes <- unique(maps$term2gene_go$gene)
primary_k2_set_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(primary_k2_gene_sets),
  function(set_name) {
    genes <- primary_k2_gene_sets[[set_name]]
    tibble::tibble(
      foreground_set = set_name,
      n_genes = length(genes),
      n_GO_annotated_genes = length(intersect(genes, go_annotated_genes)),
      GO_annotation_percent = 100 * n_GO_annotated_genes / n_genes
    )
  }
))

primary_k2_go_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(primary_k2_gene_sets),
  function(set_name) {
    run_enrichment(
      genes = primary_k2_gene_sets[[set_name]],
      universe = expressed_universe,
      term2gene = maps$term2gene_go,
      term2name = maps$term2name_go,
      database = "GO",
      background_label = "Expressed rRNA-filtered main-chromosome genes"
    ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(foreground_set = set_name)
  }
))

if (nrow(primary_k2_go_enrichment) > 0) {
  primary_k2_go_enrichment <- primary_k2_go_enrichment |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      maps$term2name_go |>
        dplyr::distinct(term, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
        dplyr::transmute(
          ID = term,
          ontology = dplyr::recode(
            ontology,
            BP = "Biological process",
            CC = "Cellular component",
            MF = "Molecular function",
            .default = NA_character_
          )
        ),
      by = "ID"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ontology)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      foreground_set = factor(foreground_set,
                              levels = primary_k2_set_levels),
      ontology = factor(ontology, levels = names(go_ontology_colors))
    )
}

primary_k2_go_significant <- primary_k2_go_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::arrange(foreground_set, ontology, p.adjust)

primary_k2_go_term_gene_index <- primary_k2_go_significant |>
  dplyr::select(foreground_set, ontology, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, Count, geneID) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") |>
  dplyr::rename(term_id = ID, term_name = Description, gene_id = geneID) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    canonical_gene_table |>
      dplyr::select(gene_id, Description, gene_biotype, DEG_context,
                    comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(foreground_set, ontology, p.adjust, term_id, gene_id)

write.csv(
  primary_k2_set_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_foreground_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  primary_k2_go_enrichment,
  file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_enrichment_all_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  primary_k2_go_significant,
  file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_enrichment_significant_terms.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  primary_k2_go_term_gene_index,
  file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_term_gene_index_long.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

primary_k2_go_plot_df <- primary_k2_go_significant |>
  dplyr::group_by(foreground_set, ontology) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(foreground_set, ontology, p.adjust) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    term_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 52),
    term_plot_id = paste(foreground_set, ontology, ID, term_label,
                         sep = "___"),
    term_plot_id = factor(term_plot_id,
                          levels = rev(unique(term_plot_id))),
    facet_panel = paste(foreground_set, ontology, sep = "\n")
  )

primary_k2_panel_levels <- unlist(lapply(
  names(go_ontology_colors),
  function(ontology_name) {
    paste(primary_k2_set_levels, ontology_name, sep = "\n")
  }
))
primary_k2_go_plot_df$facet_panel <- factor(
  primary_k2_go_plot_df$facet_panel,
  levels = primary_k2_panel_levels
)

clean_primary_go_label <- function(x) {
  sub("^.*___.*___.*___", "", x)
}

if (nrow(primary_k2_go_plot_df) > 0) {
  primary_k2_go_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    primary_k2_go_plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = term_plot_id)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(

    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = clean_primary_go_label) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "GO enrichment for all DEGs and the two primary expression clusters",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "All foregrounds use the same expressed main-chromosome background; ",
        "top 10 terms per ontology and foreground"
      ),
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      color = "GO ontology",
      size = "DEGs in term"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, color = "#111827"),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
    )

  print(primary_k2_go_plot)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_enrichment_lollipop.png"),
    primary_k2_go_plot,
    width = 36,
    height = 24,
    dpi = 260,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(out_dir, "primary_k2_GO_enrichment_lollipop.pdf"),
    primary_k2_go_plot,
    width = 36,
    height = 24,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

knitr::kable(
```

## Figure 3: two expression clusters {#Publication_figure}

The publication composite uses the two primary expression clusters. Panel A
aligns the 0-0.1% fungal-alignment zoom, treatment and diet annotations, and the
complete main-chromosome DEG heatmap by sample. Values above 0.1% are capped
only for display and retain their full percentage as enlarged white labels.
The row z-score and DEG-context guides sit in a horizontal legend strip below
panel A so the heatmap keeps its full width and the right side remains free for
an external graphical annotation. Panel A uses 80% of the exported canvas;
the remaining 20% is intentionally blank on the right for later figure assembly.
Panels B and C use only genes called differentially expressed for infected
versus control within at least one diet, then test cluster 1 and cluster 2
separately against the expressed, rRNA-filtered main-chromosome background. The
broader all-DEG GO
analysis remains available above as supporting context but is not repeated in
Figure 3. The primary KEGG panel uses the eukaryote-inclusive view: it retains
eukaryote/metazoan-compatible, conserved cross-domain, and broad KEGG reference
maps while excluding explicitly microbial/prokaryotic and disease-reference
labels. Figure 3 is exported with either a KEGG lollipop panel or the locust
pathway map. A strict insect-focused version remains available as a secondary
export, while all tested pathway scopes and genes remain in the audit tables.

```{r figure3-k2-build, fig.width=24, fig.height=24}
figure3_cluster_levels <- c("DEG cluster 1", "DEG cluster 2")

figure3_k2_assignments <- canonical_gene_table |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    k2_membership |>
      dplyr::select(gene_id, candidate_cluster),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expression_cluster = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(candidate_cluster),
      "Candidate cluster 1" = "DEG cluster 1",
      "Candidate cluster 2" = "DEG cluster 2"
    ),
    expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster,
                                levels = figure3_cluster_levels),
    DEG_context = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(DEG_context),
                                  "Other fat body DEG"),
    DEG_context = factor(DEG_context, levels = deg_context_levels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    expression_cluster,
    DEG_context,
    min_padj,
    dplyr::desc(max_abs_log2FC),
    canonical_gene_order
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
  dplyr::mutate(within_cluster_order = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

write.csv(
  figure3_k2_assignments,
  file.path(out_dir, "figure3_k2_gene_assignments.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

figure3_within_diet_sets <- list(
  "Expression cluster 1" = figure3_k2_assignments$gene_id[
    figure3_k2_assignments$expression_cluster == "DEG cluster 1" &
      figure3_k2_assignments$DEG_context == "Infection within diet"
  ],
  "Expression cluster 2" = figure3_k2_assignments$gene_id[
    figure3_k2_assignments$expression_cluster == "DEG cluster 2" &
      figure3_k2_assignments$DEG_context == "Infection within diet"
  ]
)

figure3_foreground_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  foreground_set = names(figure3_within_diet_sets),

    seq_along(figure3_within_diet_sets),

      sum(as.character(figure3_k2_assignments$expression_cluster) ==
            figure3_cluster_levels[[i]])
    },
    integer(1)
  ),
  n_infection_within_diet_genes = vapply(
    figure3_within_diet_sets,

  ),

)
write.csv(
  figure3_foreground_summary,

)

]

prepare_figure3_kegg_df <- function(display_scopes = NULL,
                                    include_ids = NULL,
                                    exclude_explicit_non_eukaryote = FALSE) {
  selected <- figure3_within_kegg_significant

  if (!is.null(display_scopes)) {
    selected <- selected |>
      dplyr::filter(pathway_scope %in% display_scopes)
  }

  if (!is.null(include_ids)) {
    selected <- selected |>
      dplyr::filter(ID %in% include_ids)
  }

  if (exclude_explicit_non_eukaryote) {
    selected <- selected |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !stringr::str_detect(
          stringr::str_to_lower(Description),
          paste0(
            "microbial|antibiotic|two-component|bacterial|quorum|",
            "peptidoglycan|lipopolysaccharide"
          )
        )
      )
  }

  selected |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      expression_cluster = dplyr::recode(
        foreground_set,
        "Expression cluster 1" = "DEG cluster 1",
        "Expression cluster 2" = "DEG cluster 2"
      ),
      expression_cluster = factor(expression_cluster,
                                  levels = figure3_cluster_levels)
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::arrange(expression_cluster, pathway_theme, p.adjust) |>
    dplyr::group_by(expression_cluster) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      pathway_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 52),
      pathway_plot_id = paste(pathway_label, dplyr::row_number(),
                              expression_cluster, sep = "___")
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway_plot_id = factor(pathway_plot_id,
                               levels = rev(unique(pathway_plot_id)))
    )
}

build_figure3_kegg_panel <- function(kegg_df, panel_title) {
  if (nrow(kegg_df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text", x = 0, y = 0,
          label = "No significant KEGG pathways in either primary cluster",
          size = 6.5,
          fontface = "bold"
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = panel_title)
    )
  }

  kegg_xmax <- max(
    c(kegg_df$neg_log10_padj, -log10(params$alpha)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  kegg_label_space <- max(9, kegg_xmax * 3.3)

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    kegg_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = pathway_plot_id)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = -kegg_label_space * 0.98,
        label = sub("___.*$", "", pathway_plot_id)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 8.2,
      lineheight = 0.95,
      color = "#111827"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = neg_log10_padj,
                   yend = pathway_plot_id),
      color = kegg_lollipop_color,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = Count),
      color = kegg_lollipop_color,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ expression_cluster, nrow = 1,
                        scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(5.5, 12)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) rep("", length(x))) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-kegg_label_space,
                 kegg_xmax + max(0.8, kegg_xmax * 0.15)),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      size = "Cluster genes in pathway"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 17),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black",
                                                 linewidth = 0.45),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#F3F4F6",
                                               color = "#111827"),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 15),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.6, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 19)
    )
}

# Map pathway summaries around a locust. Connector positions are conceptual
# physiological anchors and do not imply measured sub-tissue localization.
figure3_pathway_anchor <- function(description) {
  tibble::tibble(
    anchor_x = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Hedgehog") ~ 0.34,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Protein digestion") ~ 0.53,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Toll and Imd") ~ 0.55,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "ABC transporters") ~ 0.68,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "cytochrome P450") ~ 0.59,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Pentose") ~ 0.49,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Ascorbate") ~ 0.53,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Retinol") ~ 0.46,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "secondary metabolites") ~ 0.64,
      TRUE ~ 0.60
    ),
    anchor_y = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Hedgehog") ~ 0.58,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Protein digestion") ~ 0.43,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Toll and Imd") ~ 0.50,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "ABC transporters") ~ 0.47,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "cytochrome P450") ~ 0.43,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Pentose") ~ 0.48,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Ascorbate") ~ 0.45,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "Retinol") ~ 0.42,
      stringr::str_detect(description, "secondary metabolites") ~ 0.44,
      TRUE ~ 0.50
    )
  )
}

build_figure3_pathway_illustration <- function(kegg_df, cluster_level,
                                               connector_color) {
  selected <- kegg_df |>
    dplyr::filter(as.character(expression_cluster) == cluster_level) |>
    dplyr::arrange(pathway_theme, p.adjust) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pathway_order = dplyr::row_number())

  if (nrow(selected) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
          label = "No significant KEGG pathways",
          size = 5.5,
          fontface = "bold"
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_void() +
        ggplot2::labs(title = cluster_level)
    )
  }

  n_left <- ceiling(nrow(selected) / 2)
  selected <- selected |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      side = dplyr::if_else(pathway_order <= n_left, "left", "right")
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(side) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      callout_y = if (dplyr::n() == 1) {
        0.50
      } else {
        seq(0.80, 0.20, length.out = dplyr::n())
      }
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::bind_cols(figure3_pathway_anchor(selected$Description)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_x = dplyr::if_else(side == "left", 0.015, 0.985),
      connector_x = dplyr::if_else(side == "left", 0.225, 0.775),
      text_hjust = dplyr::if_else(side == "left", 0, 1),
      callout_label = paste0(
        stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 26),
        "\n-log10 adjusted P = ",
        scales::number(neg_log10_padj, accuracy = 0.01),
        " | ", Count, " genes"
      )
    )

  locust_grob <- grid::rasterGrob(
    png::readPNG(figure3_locust_path),
    interpolate = TRUE
  )

  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotation_custom(
      locust_grob,
      xmin = 0.23, xmax = 0.77,
      ymin = 0.25, ymax = 0.78
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = selected,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = anchor_x, y = anchor_y,
        xend = connector_x, yend = callout_y
      ),
      color = connector_color,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = selected,
      ggplot2::aes(x = anchor_x, y = anchor_y),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.6,
      stroke = 0.55,
      fill = "white",
      color = connector_color
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = selected,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = label_x, y = callout_y,
        label = callout_label,
        hjust = text_hjust
      ),
      size = 5.4,
      lineheight = 0.92,
      color = "#111827"
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0.92, ymax = 1,
      fill = "#F3F4F6",
      color = "#111827",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5, y = 0.96,
      label = cluster_level,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 6.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
      expand = FALSE,
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(
        color = "#111827", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 4, 8)
    )
}

figure3_export_specs <- list(

for (export_name in names(figure3_export_specs)) {
```

## GO enrichment

```{r go-enrichment-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=14}
go_plot_df <- go_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::group_by(background, ontology) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = params$top_terms_per_panel,
                   with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    term_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 58),
    term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label))),
    ontology = factor(ontology, levels = names(go_ontology_colors))
  )

if (nrow(go_plot_df) > 0) {
  go_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    go_plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = term_label)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = Count, color = ontology),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(ontology ~ background,
                        scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = go_ontology_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(3.5, 11)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "GO enrichment in the circled heatmap branch",
      subtitle = "Foreground is the upper branch from the all-samples full DEG heatmap",
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      color = "GO ontology",
      size = "Cluster genes in term"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  print(go_plot)
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_GO_enrichment.png"),
                  go_plot, width = 18, height = 14, dpi = 300)
} else {
  cat("No GO terms passed the adjusted p-value cutoff for this cluster.")
}
```

## KEGG pathway enrichment

```{r kegg-enrichment-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=12}
kegg_plot_df <- kegg_enrichment |>
  dplyr::filter(p.adjust <= params$alpha) |>
  dplyr::group_by(background, pathway_theme) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = params$top_terms_per_panel,
                   with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    term_label = stringr::str_wrap(Description, 55),
    term_label = factor(term_label, levels = rev(unique(term_label))),
    pathway_scope = factor(pathway_scope, levels = names(kegg_scope_colors))
  )

if (nrow(kegg_plot_df) > 0) {
  kegg_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    kegg_plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = term_label)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = -log10(params$alpha),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "#6B7280",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(size = Count),
      color = kegg_lollipop_color,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(pathway_theme ~ background,
                        scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "KEGG pathway enrichment in the circled heatmap branch",
      subtitle = "All KEGG pathway points are shown in brown; pathway scope remains in the exported tables",
      x = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      y = NULL,
      size = "Cluster genes in pathway"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  print(kegg_plot)
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "circled_cluster_KEGG_enrichment.png"),
                  kegg_plot, width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
} else {
  cat("No KEGG pathways passed the adjusted p-value cutoff for this cluster.")
}
```

## Reverse term-to-gene index

```{r reverse-term-gene-index}
gene_annotation <- circled_cluster |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id, DEG_context, phase_class, n_deg_contrasts,
                comparisons, directions, max_abs_log2FC, min_padj,
                max_abs_sample_z, sample_with_max_abs_z,
                sample_deviation_direction) |>
  dplyr::distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    gff_annotation |> dplyr::select(gene_id, Description, gene_biotype),
    by = "gene_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description = dplyr::coalesce(Description, "no GFF description"),
    gene_biotype = dplyr::coalesce(gene_biotype, "unknown")
  )

term_gene_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  expand_term_genes(go_enrichment, gene_annotation) |>
    dplyr::mutate(database = "GO"),
  expand_term_genes(kegg_enrichment, gene_annotation) |>
    dplyr::mutate(database = "KEGG_pathway")
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(database, background, p.adjust, term_id, gene_id)

term_gene_compact <- term_gene_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(database, background, term_id, term_name, GeneRatio, BgRatio,
                  p.adjust, Count) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    DEG_gene_IDs = paste(sort(unique(gene_id)), collapse = "; "),
    DEG_gene_descriptions = paste(sort(unique(Description)), collapse = "; "),
    DEG_contexts = paste(sort(unique(DEG_context)), collapse = "; "),
    strongest_deviation_samples = paste(
      sort(unique(as.character(sample_with_max_abs_z))),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(database, background, p.adjust)

write.csv(term_gene_long,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "circled_cluster_enriched_term_gene_index_long.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(term_gene_compact,
          file.path(out_dir,
                    "circled_cluster_enriched_term_gene_index_compact.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

if (nrow(term_gene_compact) > 0) {
  DT::datatable(
    term_gene_compact,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE),
    caption = "Reverse index: enriched terms and the circled-cluster genes contributing to them"
  )
} else {
  cat("No significant enriched terms were available for the reverse gene index.")
}
```
